sloka: पतितस्य कपेर् अस्य हनुर् एका शिला तले ।किम्चिद् भिन्ना दृढ हनोर् हनूमान् एष तेन वै ॥६-२८-१५॥।।
transliteration: patitasya kaper asya hanur ekā śilā tale ।kimcid bhinnā dṛḍha hanor hanūmān eṣa tena vai ॥6-28-15॥।।

translations.english: "By falling on the mountain one of the jaws of the monkey got broken. This is the reason that he is known as Hanuman."
